title: Frequency of Array Elements

content.problemStatement:
Frequency Of Element
Write a program to count the frequency of element in the array
content.inputFormat:
The first line contains the number of elements.

Second line has the array elements.
content.outputFormat: Print the number and Frequency of that number separate them by COLON

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.
Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Print frequency of each element in order of its first appearance.

code.Python3:
import sys
from collections import OrderedDict
def main():
    toks = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not toks: return
    n = int(toks[0])
    arr = [int(x) for x in toks[1:n+1]]
    counts = OrderedDict()
    for x in arr: counts[x] = counts.get(x, 0) + 1
    for k, v in counts.items(): print(f"{k}:{v}")
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

solution.editorial: Maintain an ordered map / dictionary of element frequencies and print 'elem:count' per line.

hints: Use ordered map or keep track of order of appearance.
